subject: types: fix CASE WHEN wrong result when prepare value is NULL (#62568)
summary: Fixes prepared-parameter NULL type inference by treating nil underlying values as `mysql.TypeNull` (with default charset/collation) instead of `TypeVarString`, aligning control-function (e.g. CASE WHEN) result-type inference with literal NULL and preventing wrong results under CAST/CASE. Adds an integration test reproducer for Issue #62564. No further changes to `pkg/types/field_type.go` found up to `upstream/master`.
